mechanism: Both drugs can cause renal impairment and hypocalcemia; zoledronic acid increases risk of acute kidney injury particularly in patients on ACE inhibitors, and combined use may potentiate electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) and serum electrolytes (calcium, phosphate, magnesium) before and after zoledronic acid infusion; ensure adequate hydration; consider renal dose adjustments and assess for symptoms of hypocalcemia.
